description: Ministry of Education - Cancel the land depicted in Gaz. No. 13680 - Horagasagara Piyadassi Buddhist Mixed School
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land matters, specifically the cancellation of a land acquisition order for a school property. It references a previous land acquisition order and describes the extent of land (01 Acre, 02 Roods) being affected. While it mentions a government minister by name, the core content is about land/property administration rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
